title: CSS-Tricks in Limbo
summary: CSS-Tricks, a seminal web development resource that has guided countless developers since 2007, appears to be in an uncertain state following its acquisition by SVB in 2021. The site, known for its comprehensive CSS tutorials and almanac, has not seen significant updates, leaving the web development community wondering about its future.
problem_solved: Provides awareness about the uncertain status of a major web development educational resource.
why_valuable: Highlights the precarious state of independent tech resources in the current economic climate and the impact on developer communities.
